mapper.select: SELECT * FROM admin_roles ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_roles (id, name, display_name, description, is_system, permissions, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{displayName}, #{description}, #{isSystem}, #{permissions, typeHandler=com.example.backend.config.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_roles SET name = #{name}, display_name = #{displayName}, description = #{description}, is_system = #{isSystem}, permissions = #{permissions, typeHandler=com.example.backend.config.JsonNodeTypeHandler}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
